jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (French Speaking)
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting and fulfilling new position? Join our dynamic team at WEP Clinical, where your contributions will play a key role in driving impactful solutions and improving outcomes for clients and patients. We encourage innovation and collaboration, challenging our team to bring forward ideas that make a real difference. Be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to advancing clinical research and transforming lives.

Role Objectives:

The WEP Clinical Senior Project Manager
is responsible for leading and overseeing the setup, implementation, and management of Post Approval Named Patient Programs (PA-NPP) and/or related projects.

The Ideal Candidate:

Team Player

Adaptable

Detail Oriented

Problem Solver

What You'll Do:

Lead and/or oversee regional and global PA-NPP or related projects, ensuring project timelines are met as per contract.

Ensure all program project plans, including timelines and budgets, are developed, maintained, and in compliance with the Scope of Work (SOW).

Responsible for the project team's leadership, training, and operational oversight, including overseeing delegation of support staff activities as necessary; may serve as line manager of direct report(s) in some instances.

Build and maintain positive client relationships, communicating with clients to ensure WEP Clinical operational processes are maintained and projects are delivered within scope.

Identify, evaluate, monitor, and mitigate any factors or processes that may threaten project quality (risk management), and communicate identified risks to internal team members, upper-level management, and clients as appropriate.

Develop, identify, define, and document study-specific training requirements to assure project-level compliance across projects.

Prepare and finalize Out of Scopes (OOS), ensuring Project Teams identify OOS effectively and develop effective change orders in collaboration with WEP Clinical Business Development.

Assure project teams are managing programs in accordance with WEP Clinical SOPs and Policies.

Participate in proposal meetings for potential clients.

Review documentation for the Electronic Trial Master File required for Programs, including treatment guidelines or protocols, case report forms and completion guidelines, informed consent documents, investigator agreements, investigator brochures, logic checks, data handling guidelines, and all other documents as required by the client.

In conjunction with management, assist with developing, documenting, and updating internal WEP Clinical procedures and processes required for consistency across programs, such as SOPs, working practices, and related quality assurance forms.

Provide operational oversight during Programs and projects, including reviewing site visit preparation documents, site visit reports, and site payments; audit the compilation and completion of the eTMF and CTMS; and maintain current knowledge of FDA, GDPR, and other global regulations and GCP/ICH Guidelines for Post-Approval Named Patient Programs and Clinical Research.

What You'll Need:

Fluency in French is a requirement for this role

Bachelor's Degree (in a health or science field preferred)

Significant experience and demonstrated ability in project management or clinical research, with direct clinical trial or PA-NPP experience in a CRO or research-related organization

Computer literacy and proficiency in Microsoft Office, as well as experience with an eTMF and CTMS, and an understanding of basic data processing functions, including electronic data capture

Ability to handle confidential information with complete discretion

Strong organizational, interpersonal, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and interact with all levels of staff to coordinate and execute study activities

Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to express complex ideas

Knowledge of the clinical development process from Phase I through regulatory submission, and working knowledge of current ICH GCP guidelines

Ability to reason independently to assess and recommend specific solutions in clinical settings, and to set baseline targets, track trends, and implement mitigation plans

What We Offer:

Group Private Medical Insurance

Group General Life Assurance

Group Critical Illness and Group Income Protection <span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":720,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335559991":360}"> 

Salary sacrifice pension scheme  

Enhanced maternity & paternity pay

Educational Assistance allowance

Paid volunteering day <span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":720,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335559991":360}"> 

What Sets Us Apart:

WEP Clinical partners with biopharmaceutical Sponsors to help them bring treatments closer to the patients who need them most. Through end-to-end clinical trial delivery, home health services, expanded access programs, and market access consultancy, we provide flexible, fit-for-purpose solutions that support drug development, improve access, and help therapies reach the right patients at the right time. With more than 15 years of global experience, we have supported programs across 150+ countries, combining operational scale with the agility and personalised service of a specialised provider. Our work helps bridge critical gaps in care, ensuring safe, ethical, and efficient access to promising new treatments. <span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":278}"> 

We're Committed to Our Team:

WEP has many initiatives to encourage wellness, growth, development, and team relationships. Check out our LinkedIn life page to learn more about our team events and all that we do to support our employees.

How We Work at WEP Clinical:

At WEP Clinical, we look for individuals who are conscientious, exercise sound judgement, and engage with others thoughtfully and professionally. We believe excellence is achieved through integrity, accountability, and respect for diverse perspectives – and we are committed to helping our people grow and succeed in an inclusive, supportive environment. <span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":278}">

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Drug Development
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company is advancing a portfolio of high conviction programs with strong biological validation.  Our asset-centric model offers a unique R&D logic that has been applied by single asset companies to improve productivity. This operating model has minimal centralized infrastructure, reduced hierarchy, and exclusive focus on data driven capital allocation. Our teams are uniquely incentivized to expeditiously interrogate key scientific hypotheses. We believe the asset-centric model can lead to improved success rates for programs with greater speed and modest costs.

Description Of Role

The Associate Project Manager provides portfolio-level support across teams for programs in early-late-stage development. This fully remote role focuses on maintaining accurate project timelines and budgets within a corporate-wide Project Portfolio Management (PPM) system and providing other PM support to Centessa’s portfolio of R&D programs. The position provides critical operational support to senior project managers and reports directly to the Director, Program Management.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain and update complex drug development timelines and associated budgets and long-term forecasting within a corporate-wide Project Portfolio Management (PPM) system.
Monitor individual program Smartsheet timelines to ensure consistency and accurate portfolio reporting.
Assist senior project managers with meeting logistics, agenda preparation, minutes and other PM-related activities as needed.
Monitor action items and follow up with owners to keep deliverables on schedule.
Help generate project status reports, dashboards, and RAID logs for use by program teams and leadership.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, business, or healthcare discipline. Educational coursework in project management and/or financial management would be a plus.
1–3 years of project management support within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry supporting cross-functional projects
Proven expertise in Smartsheet required and hands-on experience or proficiency with a Project Portfolio Management (PPM) system, such as Planisware, is required.
Highly detail-oriented and motivated individual with strong -software skills and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) is strongly preferred.
Basic understanding of the end-to-end drug development lifecycle (Preclinical through Phase 3 and Regulatory submission, e.g., NDA).
100% remote with the ability to work productively across multiple time zones.
Minimal travel required (less than 10% expected for team meetings or workshops).

Work Location

The Associate Project Manager, Drug Development role is a based in the US, with occasional travel.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$66,000 - $169,400

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

jobs.title: Project Manager 1, Medical Writing
jobs.description:
This role has a preferred candidate however all are encouraged to apply.

Who We Are

BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.

Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997. Our revolutionary treatments for conditions like achondroplasia (the most common form of dwarfism), PKU (phenylketonuria), CLN2, a form of Batten disease, and a number of forms of MPS (mucopolysaccharidosis) offer new possibilities for patients and families who previously had few, if any, available options. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.

Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world-class manufacturing capabilities. At the heart of BioMarin is a dedicated team of the brightest minds in the industry working together to deliver innovative therapies to patients and families around the world.

About Worldwide Research And Development

From research and discovery to post-market clinical development, our R&D engine involves all bench and clinical research and the associated groups that support those endeavors. Our teams work on developing first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with rare diseases.

This individual project manages drug development programs for the Global Medical Writing organization that range from early-stage through post approval phases for clinical development. This individual will identify and manage project-related priorities; maintain and track high-quality integrated project plans and dashboards to enable accurate reporting and decision making; enable effective team meetings and high-performance teams; manage risk assessment/escalation; develop strategies for monitoring progress and for intervention/problem-solving in collaboration with stakeholders. The Project Manager interacts with individuals within Global Medical Writing as well as across all departments ranging from Clinical Development, Regulatory, Data Sciences, and Safety.

Responsibilities

Responsible for project managing programs from early stage to post-approval for the Global Medical Writing organization.
Facilitates the integration of all key workstreams supporting the product.
Drives collaboration and transparency, while influencing the team’s critical thinking with inclusive strategic planning.
Develops detailed project schedules that integrate key activities, timelines, and tracks the critical path for assigned projects.
Develops, independently and as part of a team, decision-making methodologies, tools, and solutions for the Global Medical Writing organization to identify complex issues with cross functional mid- to long-term project- and program-level impact.
Manages project risk assessment and reporting to applicable stakeholders.
Responsible for ensuring and analyzing accurate budget and resourcing requirements are maintained within Global Medical Writing, and escalating change or out of scope requirements.
Partners with the Head of Global Medical Writing to schedule as-needed departmental Governance meetings to discuss strategy, emerging data, budget/resourcing, and align on data-driven decisions.
Manages SharePoint Team Collaboration Sites and associated dashboards for the Global Medical Writing alignment and communication.
Maintains Global Medical Writing OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), keeping the team on track and communicating change, risk and impact.
May mentor and/or supervise junior staff.
Other duties as assigned.

Experience

Required Skills:

3-6 years of work experience in drug development (pharma/biotech or contract research organization), with a minimum of 1-3 years of direct project management experience in early and/or late stage clinical development
Ability to drive, motivate and enable effective team meetings and high performing teams, while developing and maintaining professional interpersonal relationships with colleagues
Strong documentation, organization and time management skills in a fast-paced environment
Experienced with Project Professional software
Minimum: Bachelor’s (BS/BA) in Biological Sciences or closely related field

Desired Skills

Experience in the overall drug development process
1-2 years of nonclinical project management experience for IND-enabling (2+ drug class types)
Strong familiarity with Regulatory submission requirements (IND through BLA/NDA)
Experience with nonclinical study management/monitoring
Experience with Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, PowerBI (PBI) and Microsoft Teams
PMP certification preferred (or equivalent)

Note: This description is not intended to be all-inclusive, or a limitation of the duties of the position. It is intended to describe the general nature of the job that may include other duties as assumed or assigned.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

to join our team to begin an exciting and challenging career in Ashburn, VA.

The successful candidate will be responsible for working with middleware teams and technical leads for day-to-day planning, scheduling, tracking and reporting for mission critical infrastructure projects and cloud technologies. The candidate will be responsible for:

Coordinating the delivery of projects and managing all dependencies with other project teams within the organization.
Leading infrastructure teams in a hybrid work environment.
Facilitating critical conversations between stakeholders that may include shifting or competing priorities, conflict resolution and de-escalation.
Working knowledge of SELC and associated documentation (project plans, charters, business cases, requirements documents, test plans, reports, etc.)
In-depth knowledge and prior experience working with software application project teams that use an agile Scrum methodology.
Working closely with business and solution resources to define, analyze and document requirements/user stories.
Working with senior executives, clients and business analysts to gather requirements. Interpret and translate the captured technical and non-functional requirements into technical documentation that can be used by both the infrastructure team and application teams to develop software.
Prior experience with migrating on-prem technology platforms to the cloud.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience.
5+ years in agile projects – a strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
5+ years of requirements management. The candidate will oversee work milestones (end to end). This may also require coordinating & writing technical documents and business process flows.
Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
Prior experience working with system administrators .
Experience with developing SELC documents.
Skills and knowledge utilizing Windows, Microsoft Office Suite, Visio and the Atlassian suite of tools.
Strong attention to detail, highly organized and able to thrive in a busy, deadline driven atmosphere.
Ability to adapt quickly, work in a challenging and fast paced environment with a team, as well as individually.
Excellent verbal and written communications skills and organizational skills.
Commitment to learn, think creatively, and facilitate collaboration across teams.

Desired Skills and Experience:

Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification a plus.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) Certification a plus.
Familiar with:
SAP Business Objects.
Data loading/ingestion (ETL is a plus).
Security vulnerability remediation/documentation.
AWS Cloud (Cloud Concepts).

The NA Sourcing Project Manager owns the day-to-day execution of North America sourcing and production initiatives, serving as the primary link between external suppliers and internal stakeholders. This role is responsible for keeping tooling builds, supplier onboarding, production ramp-up, and quality checklist tracking on schedule and clearly communicated, freeing up leadership to focus on strategy, vendor selection, and pricing negotiations. This is a hands-on execution and coordination role supporting a focused supplier base (approximately 2–4 key NA suppliers).

Tooling Program Management

Coordinate tooling builds with NA suppliers, tracking schedules from kickoff through completion
Manage the transfer of tools from overseas to the USA, including logistics coordination and timeline tracking
Proactively identify schedule risks and escalate issues before they impact production timing

Supplier Communication & Relationship Management

New Tool Ramp-Up & Production Approvals

Quality Tracking & Reporting

Maintain clear documentation trails so issues can be traced and followed up on efficiently

Supplier Discovery & Onboarding

Conduct initial discovery and outreach to identify potential new suppliers (injection molding, metal forming, and related processes)
Vet new suppliers using the pre-built supplier onboarding checklist and compile findings for review
Participate in joint supplier visits for validation, and conduct solo follow-up visits as needed (e.g., re-inspections, ongoing validation)
Prepare clear visit summaries/reports following supplier visits, capturing both checklist results and general observations

Support new development projects specifically designed for North America production, co-designed with NA suppliers in mind
Manage timelines and schedules for NPD
Coordinate communication between internal teams and external supplier partners throughout the development process

Required Job Qualifications

3–5 years of experience managing multiple concurrent supplier-facing projects or timelines, ideally in a manufacturing or sourcing environment
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage documentation and reporting across multiple SKUs and suppliers
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable translating between external partners and internal stakeholders
Sound judgment on when to resolve an issue independently versus escalate
Comfort working independently while representing the company at supplier sites
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on experience in supplier/tooling program coordination will be considered in lieu of a degree
Familiarity with injection molding, metal forming, or similar manufacturing processes (not required, but helpful)
Prior experience with tooling programs, new product introduction (NPI), or supplier onboarding
Experience coordinating between US and Asia-based operations or suppliers

Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously
Expertise in strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, and vendor negotiations
Strong knowledge of North America manufacturing and supply chain operations
Knowledge of injection molding, tooling, and manufacturing processes
Strong analytical and numerical skills, including the ability to evaluate product costs, landed costs, pricing, and profit margins
Excellent problem-solving and strategic thinking abilities
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to influence and drive accountability across cross-functional teams and external partners
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong follow-through
Passion for sustainability and interest in responsible product development and sourcing
Comfortable working in a small, fast-paced environment and willing to wear multiple hats

Successfully manages the end-to-end North America sourcing process, from identifying and qualifying suppliers through ongoing vendor performance management

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Salary Range: 110k-142k

Replacement

The Global Trade Compliance team operates across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions in close collaboration with Husky’s Legal department. The team defines, implements, and continuously improves processes and policies to ensure compliance with global export control, sanctions, and customs regulations.

As the Global Trade Compliance Program Manager, you will report to the Director, Global Trade Compliance & Customs and serve as the program lead for enterprise-wide trade compliance initiatives. This role will focus on managing global compliance projects, optimizing processes, and ensuring the successful integration of trade compliance requirements into Husky’s systems.

You will partner with cross-functional teams—including Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Sales—to strengthen Husky’s global trade compliance framework, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce compliance risk across all regions.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Project Management

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of global trade compliance initiatives, including process optimization, technology integration, and system enhancements.
Manage the implementation of trade compliance modules within the ERP system to ensure alignment with global regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.
Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.

Regulatory Compliance and Oversight

Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.
Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.
Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.
Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.

Classification, Licensing, and Documentation

Lead efforts to standardize global product classification processes, including export control, HTS, and country-of-origin determinations.
Develop and maintain processes for end-use/end-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.
Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

Conduct global risk assessments and audits to evaluate compliance performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.
Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Training, Communication, and Stakeholder Engagement

Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.
Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.
Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.
Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

Required Experience & Education

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.
Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.
Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a global environment.

Description

Senior Technical Program Manager – Data Engineering

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Technology Organization, aligned with our Data Engineering function across the Legal vertical. This is a hands-on execution role coordinating across Data Engineering, Product Engineering, BI/Analytics, System Engineering, and NOC — where shared infrastructure, legacy systems, and evolving platforms create complex, interdependent delivery challenges. The ideal candidate is a strong self-starter who navigates ambiguity, builds cross-functional relationships, and drives business-critical initiatives with sound judgment on both immediate and long-term trade-offs.

The program portfolio spans large-scale data platform migrations, ETL/ELT pipeline development, BI reporting migrations, and data architecture modernization across legacy and modern platforms — including programs where a single infrastructure change creates cascading dependencies across multiple downstream product teams.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

Lead strategic program planning and execution – driving discovery, prioritization, milestone development, dependency management, and risk mitigation in close collaboration with product and engineering leads; communicate progress, risks, and retrospectives consistently across all stakeholder levels
Manage programs where shared data infrastructure serves as a dependency for multiple concurrently executing product teams – maintaining alignment across competing consumer priorities while the underlying platform is actively evolving
Define and track measurable success criteria for data platform programs, including pipeline SLA targets, consumer team readiness gates, data quality acceptance benchmarks, and migration sign-off standards
Proactively identify and remove impediments, lead issue resolution, and support teams balancing competing priorities
Partner with stakeholders, product managers, and engineering to translate requirements into technical execution plans, and collaborate on solution architecture from design through deployment and adoption
Ensure continuity of systems and data flows through migrations, upgrades, and platform changes – coordinating across data, application, and infrastructure layers to protect downstream consumers and production environments

Data Engineering Program Management:

Lead end-to-end planning of large-scale data platform migrations – from legacy big data clusters (e.g., Hadoop/Cloudera) to modern platforms – including migration roadmap definition, API/query/table dependency mapping, phased cutover sequencing, and multi-workstream coordination across consuming teams
Drive data quality and validation strategies for production migrations, including pre/post-migration validation frameworks, rollback plans, and sign-off criteria; track and communicate platform health, SLA adherence, and risk posture to engineering leadership
Manage complex multi-phase infrastructure upgrade programs including platform version upgrades, cluster expansions, and compute environment migrations
Facilitate alignment between data engineering teams and downstream consumers (application teams, analytics, BI, marketing operations) to ensure pipeline continuity through platform transitions
Support data governance and lineage documentation efforts to improve discoverability, quality, and reliability of data assets across the organization

Skills and Qualifications:

8+ years of TPM experience in a scaled technology organization, with a track record of managing concurrent programs spanning multiple engineering teams, product lines, and organizational boundaries simultaneously
Background in product-driven SaaS or subscription businesses where data infrastructure directly supports revenue-generating product lines
Demonstrated ability to manage programs with significant discovered scope – where initial estimates expand as dependency mapping uncovers technical complexity across multiple consuming teams
Strong stakeholder management skills in shared-infrastructure contexts, where multiple product teams have competing timelines and priorities against the same platform dependencies
Comfortable building and adapting program management workflows using low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Airtable) – including project tracking, reporting templates, and cross-team dashboards
BS/BA degree required, preferably in computer science or technical disciplines

Data Engineering Requirements:

3+ years managing data engineering programs – with demonstrated experience planning and executing complex, multi-phase data migrations including scope definition, dependency mapping, phased cutover, validation, and post-migration stabilization
Strong understanding of distributed systems and modern data architectures (data lakes, warehouses, pipelines); familiarity with big data infrastructure such as Hadoop/Cloudera, Impala, Spark, or Postgres
Experience managing cross-team dependencies between data engineering and application teams against shared APIs, tables, and pipelines; ability to engage technically with data engineers on schema design, data lineage, table partitioning, and query migration without writing code
Understanding of BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and how reporting layers depend on underlying data pipeline health
Experience managing platform version upgrades, cluster transitions, or infrastructure modernization at scale

Preferred Qualifications:

Scrum Master, Scaled Agilist, or PMP Certification
Experience owning end-to-end program strategy and communicating results to senior leadership
Track record of maintaining alignment and momentum on long-horizon programs (12+ months) where scope, priorities, and resources regularly shift – including programs where a single shared infrastructure dependency creates cascading timeline impact across multiple downstream teams

Data Engineering Preferred:

Familiarity with modern analytical data platforms (Snowflake, Apache Doris, Vertica) and data orchestration/transformation tooling (dbt, Apache Airflow, Informatica, Pentaho)
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) spanning both cloud and on-premises infrastructure
Experience managing data governance, data quality, or compliance programs (GDPR, CCPA)
Exposure to machine learning or predictive modeling programs from a TPM perspective (e.g., ML pipelines, model scoring, AI-powered analytics)

jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Join our new Radio R&D center in Yokohama

Would you like to lead challenging R&D and I&V projects while defining test strategies that secure the release, performance, and market access of next-generation Ericsson radio products?

BNEW Radio & Transport Engineering (RTE) strives to be the most competitive Radio Network R&D unit in the industry. We work in an agile setup to develop and maintain competitive, high-quality radio products that secure future growth for our customers, across LTE, WCDMA, GSM, NR/5G and the evolution toward 6G.

As an IVC Project & Test lead, you will be part of the Systems & IVC department at the Japan R&D center in Yokohama, part of Ericsson’s global RTE organization. Integration, Verification & Certification (IVC) is vital to securing product release, performance, and market access across Radio products, RAN Compute, Site products, and RAN Features impacting Radio performance.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a proactive driver with technical project experience, a strategic mind, and strong stakeholder and communication skills. You will manage and run one or several R&D/IVC projects while also taking a leading role in product test strategy, test scope, test coverage, and efficient verification execution.

Your objective will be to align project goals, time, cost, efficiency, and test results with internal and external stakeholders. You will work across Systems, Design, IVC disciplines, and technology areas to ensure that projects and test activities progress according to plan and that the right test coverage is achieved in the most efficient way.

Join our Team

What You Will Do

Understand and manage the full project scope, including product, technical, organizational, development-flow, and ways-of-working aspects.
Take responsibility and accountability for committed work, delivering according to plans and overall estimates.
Develop full-scale project plans and project-management deliverables, including schedules, cost estimates, milestones, and progress reporting.
Manage project dependencies and critical paths, identify schedule and delivery risks, and create and follow up mitigation plans.
Proactively manage changes in project and product scope, communicating impacts and decisions clearly to team members, stakeholders, and users.
Motivate project team members and influence them to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work.
Represent IVC in pre-studies and analyze the test impact of new Radio products and Features.
Drive Product Test Strategies covering several IVC disciplines for selected product segments, and build and evolve Test Plans for different products.
Drive estimation meetings with stakeholders inside and outside IVC to define test scope, coverage, effort, and delivery expectations.
Act as Project Manager for selected features or Radio products when needed, securing and facilitating test progress and handling test-scope changes with Systems and Design.
Participate in the Technology Area – Testability to capture technology trends and reflect them in IVC Test Strategies.
Continuously evaluate early-phase, development, release, and test processes and drive improvements that reduce lead time and increase coverage and efficiency.

What You Will Bring

A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
At least five years of relevant work experience, including significant experience in project management, project leadership, or test management.
Technical knowledge and practical experience with hardware and/or software development, together with experience testing HW or SW products.
Experience leading people, project teams, or cross-functional activities and building strong, highly empowered teams.
The ability to understand development flow from requirements through customer delivery and to connect product, technical, organizational, and test perspectives.
Good planning, organizing, analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Fluent spoken and written English and the confidence to present project status, risks, plans, and strategic recommendations.
RF and Radio knowledge is beneficial, as is experience with Radio HW/SW products.
Leadership experience such as OPO, team lead, or MR/SP driver is beneficial.
Lean and Agile knowledge and skills, an open-minded and innovative attitude, and an interest in constantly learning and sharing new findings.
Self-motivation, constructive questioning behavior, a positive and passionate approach to work, and a strong team-player mindset.

Why join Ericsson?
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Be part of our beating heart

Brussels Airport wil bekend staan als een van de beste luchthavens ter wereld, een volledig verbonden economische hub voor mensen en bedrijven, het kloppende hart van Europa, waar klanten, innovatie en duurzaamheid centraal staan. Wil jij de luchthaven van vandaag en morgen helpen vormgeven?

Stop met dromen en kom ons team versterken!

Brussels Airport heeft als strategische doelstellingen het nog beter presteren als hub voor zowel passagiers als cargo, haar activiteiten te diversifiëren en duurzamer te werken. Onze klanten staan hierbij steeds centraal.

Als luchthaven en als organisatie zijn we daardoor meer dan ooit in beweging en bouwen we resoluut aan de toekomst. Dit vertaalt zich in heel wat strategische projecten rond passagiers, cargo, commercieel vastgoed, operaties, infrastructuur, digitalisatie en ondersteunende bedrijfsprocessen. Om deze uitdagende project portfolio te realiseren zijn we op zoek naar gedreven Senior Project Managers die écht het verschil kunnen maken.

Als Senior Project Manager binnen het PMO team sta je op de eerste rij bij de realisatie van onze strategie. Je neemt van A tot Z de leiding in het realiseren van jouw projectresultaten binnen scope, tijd en budget. Je stuurt hierbij het projectteam aan en werkt actief samen met de sponsor, stuurgroep en andere stakeholders binnen en buiten de organisatie. Je loopt voorop, zet de lijnen uit, beheert het project proactief en brengt de juiste mensen rond tafel om samen progressie te maken. Ook het verankeren van de projectresultaten in de business behoort tot je takenpakket.

Wat je bij ons zal realiseren

Je beheert en levert diverse luchthaven gerelateerde projecten op
Je neemt van A tot Z de leiding over jouw projecten
Je presenteert investeringsvoorstellen aan het senior management, gebaseerd op business en marktanalyses, strategie en masterplan
Je vertaalt een probleemstelling naar een concreet en gedragen project en business case
Je onderhoudt actief contact met de stakeholders, om hun noden en verwachtingen beter te begrijpen en te vervullen
Je bewaakt de afgesproken scope, tijd, budget, risico’s en kwaliteit
Je neemt waar nodig ook het change en communicatie luik op
Je beheerst en stuurt proactief projecten bij om efficiëntie te verhogen, risico’s te verminderen, veranderingen te identificeren en alternatieve oplossingen voor te stellen
Je past de Brussel Airport projectmanagement methodologie toe en zorgt voor een goede documentatie en rapportering
Je coacht minder ervaren collega’s en deelt je kennis en ervaring met hen

Wat jou onderscheidt

Je behaalde een masterdiploma of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
Je hebt minstens 10 jaar ervaring als project manager in een complexe en snel veranderde omgeving
Je kunt zelfstandig en in team werken
Je kan jezelf snel in (de inhoud van) een nieuw project inwerken
Je slaagt erin om hoofd- en bijzaken van elkaar te scheiden
Je bent analytisch, hebt sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en getuigt van leiderschap
Je hebt een goede organisatiegevoeligheid en je weet de weg binnen de organisatie snel te vinden
Je bent flexibel, proactief en klantgericht
Je spreekt vlot Nederlands, daarnaast spreek je Engels en Frans

Skills

Project & Program Management
Stakeholder Management & Influencing
Risk & Issue Management
Budget & Financial Control
Strategic Planning & Execution
Change Management & Organizational Adoption
Cross-functional Team Leadership
Vendor & Contract Management
Governance, Reporting & Decision Support

Gaat je hart al sneller slaan?

Bij Brussels Airport werk je in een wereld op zich, vol nieuwe kansen en spannende uitdagingen. Je komt terecht in een unieke en inspirerende omgeving die je talenten vleugels geeft.

Wat je ervaring helemaal bijzonder maakt? Ons nieuwe Compass-gebouw met zijn prachtige panorama, ideaal uitgerust om op een hybride en flexibele manier samen te werken, waar je kan rekenen op een aantrekkelijk aanbod van extralegale voordelen voor werknemers. Daarnaast bouwen we aan een duurzame omgeving waar we met de fiets, bus of elektrische auto naartoe komen en waar we zelfs een eigen treinstation hebben. Wat wil je nog meer?

Volg het ritme van ons hart

Kan je niet wachten om jezelf te overstijgen bij Brussels Airport Company? Stuur snel jouw CV en motivatiebrief via de daarvoor bestemde link. En wie weet, misschien verwelkomen we jou heel binnenkort op onze bruisende luchthaven in het hart van Europa!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
St. John's, NL

The Cahill Group is seeking qualified candidates for a Project Manager
to support our Construction NL division in St. John’s, NL. As a Project Manager, you report directly to the Director of Projects, and will be at the center of project execution, coordinating skilled trades, subcontractors, materials, equipment, and project resources to bring complex construction scopes to life. Working closely with site supervision, clients, and internal stakeholders, you will solve challenges, drive productivity, manage project risks, and create an environment where teams can perform at their best. Your leadership will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results while maintaining Cahill's commitment to safety, operational excellence, and client success.

Success in this role requires a strong leader who thrives in a fast-paced construction environment and is passionate about building high-performing teams. You are a proactive problem solver with exceptional organizational and communication skills, capable of managing project financials, schedules, change management processes, and stakeholder relationships with confidence. Whether you're leading project meetings, mentoring teams, collaborating with unionized workforces, or working directly with clients, you'll have the opportunity to influence outcomes and contribute to a wide range of Cahill construction projects. This position will be a permanent position, working Monday to Friday, with opportunities for travel and rotational site assignments that may arise.

Role And Responsibilities

Project Pursuit & Planning:

Support business development and project pursuit activities by contributing to estimates, proposals, and bid submissions.
Review contract requirements, drawings, specifications, and client expectations to develop a thorough understanding of project scope and execution requirements.
Lead project kick-off activities and collaborate with project stakeholders to establish execution strategies, resource plans, schedules, and project objectives.
Partner with Planning and Project Controls teams to develop detailed project schedules, milestones, and performance measures.
Proactively identify project risks and opportunities and implement mitigation strategies that support successful project delivery.

Project Mobilization

Coordinate the procurement and timely delivery of materials, equipment, subcontractors, and skilled trades resources required for project execution.
Ensure project teams have the tools, information, and support necessary to safely and efficiently perform their work.
Work closely with Human Resources to coordinate unionized workforce requirements, ensuring the right resources are available to meet project demands while maintaining compliance with applicable collective agreements.
Establish project controls, reporting structures, communication plans, and document management processes.
Confirm all project safety requirements, training needs, and compliance expectations are identified and communicated before work begins.

Project Execution

Lead the day-to-day execution of assigned projects, maintaining accountability for safety, quality, productivity, schedule, and cost performance.
Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Work closely with site supervision to proactively identify and resolve field challenges, remove barriers, and maintain project momentum.
Promote and reinforce Cahill's commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence, actively supporting the goal of zero lost-time incidents.
Build strong, trusted relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and project partners, ensuring a positive project experience and responsive project delivery.
Monitor progress against project objectives and adjust execution strategies as required to achieve successful outcomes.
Maintain oversight of project costs, forecasts, budgets, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage project changes, scope growth opportunities, claims, and commercial risks while protecting the interests of both Cahill and our clients.
Oversee the timely management of RFIs, shop drawings, technical queries, contracts, and change orders to support uninterrupted project execution.
Deliver regular project performance reports and updates to senior leadership and clients.
Travel to project sites as required to support successful project delivery and client engagement.

Project Closeout & Client Success

Lead project turnover and closeout activities, ensuring all contractual obligations and deliverables are completed to the highest standard.
Coordinate the preparation and submission of handover documentation, completion records, and final project reports.
Conduct project reviews and lessons learned sessions to capture opportunities for future improvement.

What will you bring?

Degree, diploma, or technical certification in Construction Management, Engineering, Engineering Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline. Focus in electrical and mechanical areas are preferred.
Minimum 5-10 years of progressive experience managing industrial, commercial, infrastructure, or heavy construction projects.
Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification is an asset but not a requirement.
Experience leading projects from pre-construction planning through execution, turnover, and closeout.
Ability to interpret project schedules, reports, and project performance metrics to support informed decision-making.
Ability to focus on safe and effective execution of multiple projects.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite of programs.
Strong negotiation, evaluation, and organizational skills.

The Cahill Group is one of the largest multi-disciplinary construction companies in Canada. Cahill is building the future of energy, mining, hydro, and social infrastructure on some of the largest construction and fabrication project sites in the country. People really are at the heart of everything we do. So, we will always put the health, well-being, and safety of our people above all. We take care of our people, through investment, training, competitive compensation, health plan benefits, and unique programs to support the health and well-being of you and your family.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive culture creates a work environment that is supportive, engaging and rewarding. We welcome, recognize, and celebrate diverse backgrounds, cultures, demographics, perspectives, and experiences within our team. Being you at The Cahill Group is what makes us stronger and enables innovation and creativity in meeting tomorrow’s challenges. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to recruit a diverse and talented workforce. If you require any accommodation in the recruitment process, please let us know. While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Business Process & Program Excellence
jobs.description:
Job Summary

NetApp is seeking a highly motivated Program Manager to join our Customer Success organization and drive strategic business transformation initiatives across Renewals, Commerce, Customer Success, Operations, and IT. This role combines the skills of a Program Manager, Business Process Analyst, and Process Architect. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve operational efficiency, business processes, data quality, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, possesses strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, and can effectively partner across multiple organizations to identify root causes, evaluate solution options, and drive execution. This role requires strong leadership presence, data-driven decision-making, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence without authority across a matrixed global organization.

This role is based in San Jose, CA, and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite***

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

Lead and manage complex cross-functional programs from initiation through execution and business adoption.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into structured project plans, milestones, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and maintain project governance, including status reporting, risk management, dependency tracking, issue resolution, and executive communications.
Create and maintain project dashboards, Kanban boards, scorecards, and program reporting mechanisms.
Facilitate regular program reviews and drive accountability across stakeholders.
Drive weekly operating rhythms, executive updates, and cross-functional decision forums.

Business Analysis & Problem Solving

Investigate operational challenges by collecting and analyzing business, process, system, and operational data.
Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, Commerce, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, and other functions to identify root causes.
Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to evaluate solution options and provide actionable recommendations.
Develop business cases and present data-driven recommendations to leadership teams.
Translate business challenges into clearly defined requirements, opportunities, and improvement initiatives.

Business Process Architecture & Process Excellence

Lead discovery sessions to understand and document end-to-end business processes across multiple organizations.
Develop current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) process flows.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, automation, and optimization.
Assess upstream and downstream impacts of process and system changes.
Partner with business and technical teams to ensure scalable and sustainable process designs.
Drive adoption of process excellence principles and best practices across transformation initiatives.
Document business requirements, decision logs, process maps, operating procedures, and implementation impacts.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Build trusted relationships across business and technical organizations.
Facilitate cross-functional discussions that drive clarity, decisions, and alignment.
Communicate complex issues, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and executive-ready manner.
Influence stakeholders and drive progress within a highly matrixed environment.
Support geographically distributed teams and collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.

Data-Driven Decision Support

Leverage data to identify issues, validate assumptions, quantify business impact, and support recommendations.
Create dashboards, scorecards, and executive summaries that enable informed decision-making.
Present findings and recommendations with clear data-backed rationale.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Business Process Management, Consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives.
Strong business analysis, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Experience documenting and improving business processes, including development of As-Is and To-Be process flows.
Experience creating project plans, executive status reports, dashboards, RAID logs, and governance frameworks.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive decisions and recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority.
Experience working effectively in global, highly matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within SaaS, Subscription, Renewals, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Commerce, or Quote-to-Cash environments.
Experience working with enterprise business systems and transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, and other business process modeling methodologies.
Experience with Figma, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, Tableau, Power BI, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools.
Experience supporting UAT, business readiness, change management, and operational adoption.
PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma, or Business Process certifications are highly desired.

Success Profile

The Ideal Candidate Is

A structured problem solver who enjoys tackling complex business challenges.
A process-oriented thinker who naturally looks for opportunities to simplify and improve.
A data-driven decision-maker who can translate analysis into business recommendations.
A strong communicator with the confidence to engage senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
A proactive program manager who can bring order and execution discipline to ambiguous initiatives.
A collaborative leader who builds trust and drives alignment across organizations.
Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced global environment.
Comfortable working across multiple time zones to drive outcomes and remove barriers.

Compensation

The target salary range for this position is 100,300 - 149,600 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

jobs.description:
About Nua

Nua is a venture-funded, direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand transforming women’s wellness in India. Starting with our innovative, chemical-free and India’s only fully customisable sanitary pads, we are on a mission to develop holistic and personalized solutions for solving real problems that women face. We do this by building a wellness platform with great products, an impactful community and a personalized customer experience. With a growing community of over 15 lakh women, we are already India’s largest and most engaged digital-first FemTech brand. Our story began with a pad. And not just any pad that could be picked off the shelves but one that was truly thought around a woman’s needs. Since then, we have grown multi-fold with innovative, inclusive and effective products that are Made Safe certified and backed by science. We continue to co-create products with our community and fuel the D2C revolution through deep consumer insights and investments in technology. Nua has raised over $22 million in venture funding, backed by marquee investors including Lightbox Ventures, Kae Capital, Mirabilis Investment Trust, Deepika Padukone and Vindi Singh Banga, and Kamini Banga of the Banga family office. If you are as passionate as we are in making a difference and creating real impact in a fast-paced and wildly creative environment, then you might just be the person we are looking for.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Company Description

Moveworks
is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Implementation Manager oversees the on-time, on-budget delivery of the Moveworks platform to meet the customer's desired results. This requires completing projects following leading practice methodology, working in collaboration with the customer project team and any involved partner, ensuring governance is followed to gain stakeholder support, including risk and issue mitigation. The Implementation Manager is responsible for assembling and leading project resources, ensuring they understand planned tasks, tracking progress, and managing deviations through appropriate measures.

Lead customers through the initial implementation of Moveworks as well as new product offerings, often in collaboration with a services partner.

Work with Sales, partners, and customers to understand the customer and the engagement, including challenges, issues, and value being delivered.
Understand customer goals and align deliverables accordingly.
Be the single point of contact to encourage collaboration and customer agreement on proposed solutions.
Mentor team members and partners to achieve engagement deliverables and promote the customer's desired results.
Identify gaps between actuals and plan of record, proposing solutions and driving resolutions.
Partner with the Product organization as a champion for customers, sharing insights from the field in product design and development cycles.
Partner with Customer Success Managers to ensure a seamless transition to post-launch engagement and support.

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

Project management experience including scope control, budgeting, estimating, and resource management.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.
Ability to creatively propose technical solutions to challenging problems and communicate technical concepts clearly and efficiently.
Process-focused with strong problem-solving ability—always searching for a smarter, better way to achieve a goal.
Experience building strong internal and external relationships, including with senior-level executives.
Creativity with comfort running projects independently.
Experience driving complex issues through analysis and resolution.

Diplomatic, tactful, and poised under pressure.

jobs.description:
Gestalte IT-Projekte aktiv und übernimm Verantwortung dort, wo deine Entscheidungen Wirkung zeigen. Bringe deine Beratungskompetenz, dein Projekt-Know-how und deine Eigeninitiative ein, um Kund*innen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln und Potenziale sichtbar zu machen.

Was du bei uns machst

Du übernimmst die fachliche und organisatorische Leitung anspruchsvoller IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und bringst Kund*innen sicher auf ihrer Cloud Journey voran.
Du berätst proaktiv in Business Consulting-Fragestellungen und Prozessoptimierungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT, identifizierst Potenziale und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungsansätze.
Digitalisierung, Collaboration und Cloud-Shift sind für dich nicht nur Schlagworte, sondern du denkst und handelst entlang moderner IT- und Geschäftsprozesse, um echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.
Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst Projekte agil, klassisch oder hybrid – dabei kannst du je nach Bedarf auch in der Rolle eines (Technical) Product Owners beim Kunden agieren.
Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse aktueller IT-Trend-Themen mit, insbesondere zu Cloud-Hyperscalern wie AWS oder Microsoft Azure, und setzt diese gezielt zur Lösung operativer und strategischer Herausforderungen ein.
Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend auf allen Ebenen – intern im Team wie auch beim Kunden – und präsentierst Ergebnisse, Roadmaps und Empfehlungen professionell und zielführend.

Wann du zu uns passt

Du hast fundierte Berufserfahrung in der IT-Projektsteuerung bzw. des Business Consultings und hast dementsprechend in mehreren Projekten erfolgreich mitgewirkt.
In den Methoden des Projektmanagements kennst du dich bestens aus und kannst diese je nach Kundenszenario anwenden.
Du hast Spaß an der Beratung, wechselnden Kund*innen und Einsatzorten sowie Lust, technologisch und methodisch stets mit der Zeit zu gehen und dich in ein engagiertes Team einzubringen.
Du besitzt ein Consulting-Mindset, sprich du suchst dir eigenständig Aufgaben bei Kund*innen, stimmst dich aktiv ab, maximierst deine Auslastung und managst diese selbst.
Die Unterstützung und Begleitung von Veränderungsprozessen bei Kund*innen sind selbstverständliche Bestandteile deines Handelns.

Hey, wir sind Skaylink.

Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien.

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen.

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst.

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig.

– Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)

🏆 Events
– Zusammenkommen und Feiern (u. a. Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents, Cross-Company Tech-Talks)

🧩 Miteinander
– We are Skaylink!

Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match?

Dann bewirb dich – auch falls du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst! Wir benötigen nur deinen Lebenslauf und sind schon ganz gespannt darauf, von dir zu lesen.

Wir freuen uns auf die gemeinsame (Cloud) Journey mit dir!

Responsable Data Science / IA.

Analyse et cadrage des besoins : Traduire les attentes métier en spécifications techniques pour la définition des KPIs et des indicateurs de performance.

Automatisation des process : Automatiser les flux et tâches répétitives via Power Automate et des scripts Python pour optimiser l'efficacité opérationnelle.
Accompagnement métier : Documenter les indicateurs créés et assurer le lien technique/fonctionnel pour vulgariser la donnée auprès des équipes.

Profil

Formation :
Diplôme de niveau Bac +3 à Bac +5 en informatique décisionnelle, data analyse, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent, complété par une expérience professionnelle d’environ 2 ans sur un poste similaire.

○ Maîtrise du langage SQL pour l'interrogation de bases de données.

○ Pratique opérationnelle de Power BI (création de visualisations, modèles de données, bases solides en DAX, M).

○ Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment d'Excel (niveau avancé).

Les "Plus" appréciés :

○ Une maîtrise de Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux.

○ Des notions en Python (Pandas, Polars, NumPy) pour la manipulation de données et l'automatisation.

○ Une connaissance de l'environnement Azure (notamment Microsoft Fabric) et de l'outil Git.

○ L'utilisation ou la connaissance d'un data catalogue, idéalement Data Galaxy .

○ Curiosité ou expérience dans le secteur du transport aérien (opérations de vol, données clients, etc.).

Soft Skills :

○ Esprit d'analyse, méthode et rigueur pour assurer la fiabilité des restitutions.

○ Excellente capacité de communication et de pédagogie.

○ Autonomie et force de proposition.

Job Description

The DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer for Husky will be responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining the company’s enterprise business intelligence ecosystem, leveraging both internal and external data sources. Strong understanding of ERP and operational system data structures, with the ability to interpret, navigate, and optimize complex relational databases.
Advanced proficiency in writing high‑performance SQL queries against large‑scale, complex datasets, including optimization and troubleshooting.
Hands‑on experience in data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling, with the ability to translate analytical insights into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives.
Experience designing, debugging, and deploying BI solutions within an Azure DevOps (ADO) environment, including CI/CD practices, version control, and release management.

Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices, Power BI Service)
