St. John's, NL

The Cahill Group is seeking qualified candidates for a Project Manager
to support our Construction NL division in St. John’s, NL. As a Project Manager, you report directly to the Director of Projects, and will be at the center of project execution, coordinating skilled trades, subcontractors, materials, equipment, and project resources to bring complex construction scopes to life. Working closely with site supervision, clients, and internal stakeholders, you will solve challenges, drive productivity, manage project risks, and create an environment where teams can perform at their best. Your leadership will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results while maintaining Cahill's commitment to safety, operational excellence, and client success.

Success in this role requires a strong leader who thrives in a fast-paced construction environment and is passionate about building high-performing teams. You are a proactive problem solver with exceptional organizational and communication skills, capable of managing project financials, schedules, change management processes, and stakeholder relationships with confidence. Whether you're leading project meetings, mentoring teams, collaborating with unionized workforces, or working directly with clients, you'll have the opportunity to influence outcomes and contribute to a wide range of Cahill construction projects. This position will be a permanent position, working Monday to Friday, with opportunities for travel and rotational site assignments that may arise.

Role And Responsibilities

Project Pursuit & Planning:

Support business development and project pursuit activities by contributing to estimates, proposals, and bid submissions.
Review contract requirements, drawings, specifications, and client expectations to develop a thorough understanding of project scope and execution requirements.
Lead project kick-off activities and collaborate with project stakeholders to establish execution strategies, resource plans, schedules, and project objectives.
Partner with Planning and Project Controls teams to develop detailed project schedules, milestones, and performance measures.
Proactively identify project risks and opportunities and implement mitigation strategies that support successful project delivery.

Project Mobilization

Coordinate the procurement and timely delivery of materials, equipment, subcontractors, and skilled trades resources required for project execution.
Ensure project teams have the tools, information, and support necessary to safely and efficiently perform their work.
Work closely with Human Resources to coordinate unionized workforce requirements, ensuring the right resources are available to meet project demands while maintaining compliance with applicable collective agreements.
Establish project controls, reporting structures, communication plans, and document management processes.
Confirm all project safety requirements, training needs, and compliance expectations are identified and communicated before work begins.

Project Execution

Lead the day-to-day execution of assigned projects, maintaining accountability for safety, quality, productivity, schedule, and cost performance.
Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Work closely with site supervision to proactively identify and resolve field challenges, remove barriers, and maintain project momentum.
Promote and reinforce Cahill's commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence, actively supporting the goal of zero lost-time incidents.
Build strong, trusted relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and project partners, ensuring a positive project experience and responsive project delivery.
Monitor progress against project objectives and adjust execution strategies as required to achieve successful outcomes.
Maintain oversight of project costs, forecasts, budgets, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage project changes, scope growth opportunities, claims, and commercial risks while protecting the interests of both Cahill and our clients.
Oversee the timely management of RFIs, shop drawings, technical queries, contracts, and change orders to support uninterrupted project execution.
Deliver regular project performance reports and updates to senior leadership and clients.
Travel to project sites as required to support successful project delivery and client engagement.

Project Closeout & Client Success

Lead project turnover and closeout activities, ensuring all contractual obligations and deliverables are completed to the highest standard.
Coordinate the preparation and submission of handover documentation, completion records, and final project reports.
Conduct project reviews and lessons learned sessions to capture opportunities for future improvement.

What will you bring?

Degree, diploma, or technical certification in Construction Management, Engineering, Engineering Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline. Focus in electrical and mechanical areas are preferred.
Minimum 5-10 years of progressive experience managing industrial, commercial, infrastructure, or heavy construction projects.
Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification is an asset but not a requirement.
Experience leading projects from pre-construction planning through execution, turnover, and closeout.
Ability to interpret project schedules, reports, and project performance metrics to support informed decision-making.
Ability to focus on safe and effective execution of multiple projects.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite of programs.
Strong negotiation, evaluation, and organizational skills.

The Cahill Group is one of the largest multi-disciplinary construction companies in Canada. Cahill is building the future of energy, mining, hydro, and social infrastructure on some of the largest construction and fabrication project sites in the country. People really are at the heart of everything we do. So, we will always put the health, well-being, and safety of our people above all. We take care of our people, through investment, training, competitive compensation, health plan benefits, and unique programs to support the health and well-being of you and your family.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive culture creates a work environment that is supportive, engaging and rewarding. We welcome, recognize, and celebrate diverse backgrounds, cultures, demographics, perspectives, and experiences within our team. Being you at The Cahill Group is what makes us stronger and enables innovation and creativity in meeting tomorrow’s challenges. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to recruit a diverse and talented workforce. If you require any accommodation in the recruitment process, please let us know. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve operational efficiency, business processes, data quality, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, possesses strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, and can effectively partner across multiple organizations to identify root causes, evaluate solution options, and drive execution. This role requires strong leadership presence, data-driven decision-making, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence without authority across a matrixed global organization.

This role is based in San Jose, CA, and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite***

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

Lead and manage complex cross-functional programs from initiation through execution and business adoption.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into structured project plans, milestones, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and maintain project governance, including status reporting, risk management, dependency tracking, issue resolution, and executive communications.
Create and maintain project dashboards, Kanban boards, scorecards, and program reporting mechanisms.
Facilitate regular program reviews and drive accountability across stakeholders.
Drive weekly operating rhythms, executive updates, and cross-functional decision forums.

Business Analysis & Problem Solving

Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, Commerce, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, and other functions to identify root causes.
Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to evaluate solution options and provide actionable recommendations.
Develop business cases and present data-driven recommendations to leadership teams.
Translate business challenges into clearly defined requirements, opportunities, and improvement initiatives.

Develop current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) process flows.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, automation, and optimization.
Assess upstream and downstream impacts of process and system changes.
Partner with business and technical teams to ensure scalable and sustainable process designs.
Drive adoption of process excellence principles and best practices across transformation initiatives.
Document business requirements, decision logs, process maps, operating procedures, and implementation impacts.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Build trusted relationships across business and technical organizations.
Facilitate cross-functional discussions that drive clarity, decisions, and alignment.
Communicate complex issues, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and executive-ready manner.
Influence stakeholders and drive progress within a highly matrixed environment.
Support geographically distributed teams and collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.

Data-Driven Decision Support

Create dashboards, scorecards, and executive summaries that enable informed decision-making.
Present findings and recommendations with clear data-backed rationale.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Business Process Management, Consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives.
Strong business analysis, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Experience documenting and improving business processes, including development of As-Is and To-Be process flows.
Experience creating project plans, executive status reports, dashboards, RAID logs, and governance frameworks.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive decisions and recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority.
Experience working effectively in global, highly matrixed organizations.

Experience within SaaS, Subscription, Renewals, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Commerce, or Quote-to-Cash environments.
Experience working with enterprise business systems and transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, and other business process modeling methodologies.

Success Profile

A structured problem solver who enjoys tackling complex business challenges.
A process-oriented thinker who naturally looks for opportunities to simplify and improve.
A data-driven decision-maker who can translate analysis into business recommendations.
A strong communicator with the confidence to engage senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
A proactive program manager who can bring order and execution discipline to ambiguous initiatives.
A collaborative leader who builds trust and drives alignment across organizations.
Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced global environment.

Moveworks

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Partner with the Product organization as a champion for customers, sharing insights from the field in product design and development cycles.
Partner with Customer Success Managers to ensure a seamless transition to post-launch engagement and support.

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Bachelor's degree.

À propos de nous

Air Caraïbes, compagnie aérienne antillaise, relie la France métropolitaine aux Caraïbes avec passion et expertise. Notre mission : offrir un service chaleureux et de qualité, tout en valorisant notre ancrage régional et notre esprit d'innovation. Rejoignez une équipe engagée et tournée vers l’excellence.

Nous recrutons un Data Analyst en CDI , base Guadeloupe

Statut Cadre

Mission

En Tant Que Data Analyst, Vous Relevez

Hiérarchiquement :
Responsable Data Science / IA.

Fonctionnellement :
Directeur des Systèmes d’Information et de la Sécurité.

Pivot entre la DSI et les métiers, vous valorisez les données de l'entreprise pour en optimiser l'usage au quotidien. Votre rôle central consiste à transformer les données en leviers de décision stratégiques via la création d'outils décisionnels et de solutions BI performantes.

Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Data Science / IA, vous participez activement à la valorisation des données de l'entreprise :

Analyse et cadrage des besoins : Traduire les attentes métier en spécifications techniques pour la définition des KPIs et des indicateurs de performance.
Modélisation et conception BI : Concevoir des modèles de données robustes et développer des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI pour faciliter le pilotage stratégique.
Requêtage et extraction : Interroger les bases de données relationnelles (SQL) pour extraire les informations pertinentes en réponse aux problématiques métiers.
Préparation des données : Structurer et nettoyer les datasets via Power Query (M) ou des scripts d'analyse (Python).
Automatisation des process : Automatiser les flux et tâches répétitives via Power Automate et des scripts Python pour optimiser l'efficacité opérationnelle.
Accompagnement métier : Documenter les indicateurs créés et assurer le lien technique/fonctionnel pour vulgariser la donnée auprès des équipes.
Veille et amélioration continue : Se tenir informé des nouvelles méthodes et outils d'analyse de données pour optimiser les processus existants.

Profil

Formation :
Diplôme de niveau Bac +3 à Bac +5 en informatique décisionnelle, data analyse, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent, complété par une expérience professionnelle d’environ 2 ans sur un poste similaire.

Compétences techniques requises :

○ Maîtrise du langage SQL pour l'interrogation de bases de données.

○ Pratique opérationnelle de Power BI (création de visualisations, modèles de données, bases solides en DAX, M).

○ Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment d'Excel (niveau avancé).

Les "Plus" appréciés :

○ Une maîtrise de Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux.

○ Des notions en Python (Pandas, Polars, NumPy) pour la manipulation de données et l'automatisation.

○ Une connaissance de l'environnement Azure (notamment Microsoft Fabric) et de l'outil Git.

○ L'utilisation ou la connaissance d'un data catalogue, idéalement Data Galaxy .

○ Curiosité ou expérience dans le secteur du transport aérien (opérations de vol, données clients, etc.).

Soft Skills :

○ Esprit d'analyse, méthode et rigueur pour assurer la fiabilité des restitutions.

○ Excellente capacité de communication et de pédagogie.

○ Autonomie et force de proposition.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Summary

Senior Business Analysts are trusted partners to the business functions they serve. Their credibility as advisors

rests on expertise they actively build and apply: deep knowledge of CA’s organizational ecosystem, fluency in how

peers and the broader industry tackle the same challenges, and command of the functional discipline itself -- the

frameworks, standards, and emerging practices that define what good looks like. This combination is what allows

them to bring recommendations grounded in both CA’s context and a wider reference point. Sr. BAs shape how

problems are framed, not just how requirements are structured. They anticipate downstream impacts before

anyone asks. They are present in the operating rhythm of the business, not just the project lifecycle. Senior BAs

also invest in the broader BA team -- mentoring peers, raising the quality bar through their own work, and

contributing to the standards and methods that define how the function operates.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a trusted advisor to business within the assigned domain -- present and accessible in the

business’s operating rhythm, not just project ceremonies.

Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; understand their priorities, constraints, and

context well enough to anticipate needs before they’re articulated.

Lead discovery for complex, multi-team initiatives; facilitate workshops and alignment sessions that

produce decisions, not just documentation.

Drive cross-functional alignment across competing priorities; resolve independently where possible, and

know when to bring in IT Business Partnering leadership or peer domain BAs to reach the right outcome.

Mentor peers on discovery, stakeholder engagement, and requirements quality; contribute patterns and

examples to the broader BA practice.

Requirements & Problem Definition

Shape and reframe problem statements; challenge assumptions and identify root causes that stakeholders

may not have fully surfaced.

Structure complex, ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements for high-complexity

solutions -- with minimal rework from QA or development.

Anticipate downstream technical and business impacts; surface risks before they become blockers.
Connect individual initiative requirements to broader domain and organizational priorities -- visible in

every piece of work, not just strategic conversations.

Delivery Collaboration

Actively shape refinement and sprint planning across complex, multi-team initiatives.
Hold accountability for requirements quality across the full initiative; QA and UAT surface few surprises

attributable to gaps.

Lead UAT coordination: own coverage, quality, and completeness across multiple teams and workstreams.
Drive post-deployment validation and change management; track adoption, surface issues before they compound, and stay present until solutions are working as intended. Domain Knowledge & Documentation
Own the accuracy, currency, and depth of process maps and documentation across the entire assigned domain -- beyond individual project cycles.
Build and apply contextual experience within the assigned domain: understanding why current processes and rules exist, what’s been tried before and what happened, where the recurring pain points are, and how the domain has evolved.
Recognize patterns that come with domain experience -- downstream impacts that aren’t obvious without context, approaches that were tried and didn’t work, trends that signal where the domain is heading -- and use that recognition to sharpen requirements and surface risks early. Knowledge Engineering & AI Enablement
Own the domain-level knowledge base: business rules, process maps, and entity definitions structured for reuse by both human practitioners and AI tools.
Design multi-step AI-assisted workflows for domain-level tasks; define the sequencing, inputs, outputs, and validation checkpoints for each.
Set validation standards for the domain -- documented criteria for what ’good enough’ looks like for AI-assisted outputs on each class of task (stories, epics, test cases, etc.).
Build and maintain a domain-level agent-readiness map: which tasks are agent-assisted, which require human judgment, and why -- reviewed quarterly.
Conduct periodic agent accuracy reviews; diagnose systematic errors at the root cause -- missing context, rule gaps, prompt quality -- not just surface symptoms. Strategic Contribution
Proactively identify functional-level gaps and opportunities; bring recommendations with supporting rationale, not just observations.
Drive improvements to BA team standards, templates, and toolkits; identify gaps and propose enhancements to the practice.
Contribute to BA hiring, onboarding, and community of practice as an active participant and knowledge contributor. Success Measures & Expectations
Senior business partners describe the Sr. BA as a trusted advisor, not just a project resource -- evidenced by proactive outreach, inclusion in planning conversations, and first-call behavior when something goes wrong.
Requirements for complex initiatives are complete, root-cause-driven, and traceable to delivered solutions; rework attributable to requirements gaps is rare and declining.
Domain KE artifacts (rule sets, process maps, entity definitions) are complete, SME-validated, and current; coverage of the domain is measurable and tracked.
Agent accuracy within the domain is measurable and trending positively quarter over quarter; root causes of systematic errors are documented and addressed.
BAs mentored by this Sr. BA show measurable improvement in requirements quality and delivery confidence over a 6-month period.
Domain documentation passes review without significant revision; industry and functional context is visibly incorporated into recommendations.
Business partners at the director level and above report high satisfaction with communication, alignment, and outcomes. What This Role Is Not
Not a project manager. Sr. BAs shape delivery by ensuring requirements are clear, decisions are made, and stakeholders are aligned -- not by owning timelines or resource plans.
Not a technical architect. Sr. BAs define what solutions must do and why; how they do it belongs to the technical team.
Not the default UAT execution owner. Sr. BAs set UAT strategy and ensure coverage; test execution and sign-off belong to QA and business stakeholders.
Not a domain validator for areas outside their assignment. Cross-domain knowledge is an asset; accountability for domains they don’t own isn’t theirs to carry.
Not an unsupervised AI operator. Sr. BAs design and govern agent workflows -- they do not deploy agent outputs without documented human review.
Not a catch-all for delivery gaps. Being a trusted partner means being an active presence -- not the person who absorbs whatever falls through the cracks. Required Job Skills and Abilities: Required:
5+ years of experience in business analysis, Sales Operations, data analysis, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in cross-functional project leadership and communication.
3+ years of experience in requirement gathering and documenting user stories.
3+ years of Business Analyst or SME expertise in CRM and data platforms (Salesforce, Snowflake, etc.).
High proficiency in process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) and a solid understanding of SDLC (Agile/Waterfall). We’d also like to see:
Business Analyst certifications such as CBAP, CCBA.
Salesforce or data tool certifications.
Experience in EdTech or Publishing. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred; or equivalent on the job experience.

Travel: Travel may include office visits, trainings, and conferences. We are estimating that average travel should be

once per quarter.

Benefits And Pay Range

Pay Range – This role’s range is $81,500 - $139,500. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation
new_jobs.description:
Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. Summary

Senior Business Analysts are trusted partners to the business functions they serve. Their credibility as advisors

rests on expertise they actively build and apply: deep knowledge of CA’s organizational ecosystem, fluency in how

peers and the broader industry tackle the same challenges, and command of the functional discipline itself -- the

frameworks, standards, and emerging practices that define what good looks like. This combination is what allows

problems are framed, not just how requirements are structured. They anticipate downstream impacts before

anyone asks. They are present in the operating rhythm of the business, not just the project lifecycle. Senior BAs

also invest in the broader BA team -- mentoring peers, raising the quality bar through their own work, and

contributing to the standards and methods that define how the function operates.

This Sr. BA role will serve as the trusted partner to the Marketing function, translating marketing process and system needs into clear, actionable IT requirements. Focus areas include marketing technology (martech) systems, data flows between marketing and CRM/CDP platforms, campaign and lead-management process design, and reporting/analytics infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings IT business analysis fundamentals — requirements gathering, systems thinking, SDLC/Agile delivery — plus enough marketing domain fluency to partner credibly with Marketing stakeholders, and works cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Operations, and IT delivery teams to scope and deliver system and process improvements.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a trusted advisor to business within the assigned domain -- present and accessible in the

business’s operating rhythm, not just project ceremonies.

Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; understand their priorities, constraints, and

context well enough to anticipate needs before they’re articulated.

Lead discovery for complex, multi-team initiatives; facilitate workshops and alignment sessions that

produce decisions, not just documentation.

Drive cross-functional alignment across competing priorities; resolve independently where possible, and

know when to bring in IT Business Partnering leadership or peer domain BAs to reach the right outcome.

Mentor peers on discovery, stakeholder engagement, and requirements quality; contribute patterns and

examples to the broader BA practice.

Requirements & Problem Definition

Shape and reframe problem statements; challenge assumptions and identify root causes that stakeholders

may not have fully surfaced.

Structure complex, ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements for high-complexity

solutions -- with minimal rework from QA or development.

Anticipate downstream technical and business impacts; surface risks before they become blockers.
Connect individual initiative requirements to broader domain and organizational priorities -- visible in

every piece of work, not just strategic conversations.

Delivery Collaboration

Actively shape refinement and sprint planning across complex, multi-team initiatives.
Hold accountability for requirements quality across the full initiative; QA and UAT surface few surprises

attributable to gaps.

Lead UAT coordination: own coverage, quality, and completeness across multiple teams and workstreams.
Drive post-deployment validation and change management; track adoption, surface issues before they compound, and stay present until solutions are working as intended. Domain Knowledge & Documentation
Own the accuracy, currency, and depth of process maps and documentation across the entire assigned domain -- beyond individual project cycles.
Build and apply contextual experience within the assigned domain: understanding why current processes and rules exist, what’s been tried before and what happened, where the recurring pain points are, and how the domain has evolved.
Recognize patterns that come with domain experience -- downstream impacts that aren’t obvious without context, approaches that were tried and didn’t work, trends that signal where the domain is heading -- and use that recognition to sharpen requirements and surface risks early. Knowledge Engineering & AI Enablement
Own the domain-level knowledge base: business rules, process maps, and entity definitions structured for reuse by both human practitioners and AI tools.
Design multi-step AI-assisted workflows for domain-level tasks; define the sequencing, inputs, outputs, and validation checkpoints for each.
Set validation standards for the domain -- documented criteria for what ’good enough’ looks like for AI-assisted outputs on each class of task (stories, epics, test cases, etc.).
Build and maintain a domain-level agent-readiness map: which tasks are agent-assisted, which require human judgment, and why -- reviewed quarterly.
Conduct periodic agent accuracy reviews; diagnose systematic errors at the root cause -- missing context, rule gaps, prompt quality -- not just surface symptoms. Strategic Contribution
Proactively identify functional-level gaps and opportunities; bring recommendations with supporting rationale, not just observations.
Drive improvements to BA team standards, templates, and toolkits; identify gaps and propose enhancements to the practice.
Contribute to BA hiring, onboarding, and community of practice as an active participant and knowledge contributor.

Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

We are seeking a passionate and talented Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. You will turn complex data from our Medicine Supply Map into actionable insights that drive decision-making, operational improvements, and ensure the availability of quality medicines.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. Gather, clean, preprocess, and maintain datasets from the Medicine Supply Map and related sources.

Conduct statistical analysis and hypothesis testing to uncover trends, patterns, and anomalies.
Design, plan, and execute data quality and testing activities: validate datasets, uncover data issues, check pipeline integrity, and implement consistency checks.

Develop clear dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools like Python (Pandas, Matplotlib), R, SQL, Tableau, SAS.
Monitor data pipelines, verify data flow correctness, and troubleshoot discrepancies.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define reporting needs and deliver actionable insights.
Perform root cause and diagnostic analytics to understand supply disruptions or demand shifts.
Share insights through presentations, written reports, and visual storytelling.
Document testing procedures, data validation steps, and analytical methodology.
Stay current on emerging analytics, testing tools, and best practices in healthcare/pharmaceutical data.

Who is USP Looking For?

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Public Health, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in data cleaning, transformation, and analysis using Python (Pandas), R, SQL, Tableau, SAS, or similar tools.
Strong statistical foundation: hypothesis testing, trend analysis, descriptive and diagnostic statistics.
Experience building dashboards or visualizations to communicate data insights clearly.
Excellent analytical thinking and attention to detail; ability to translate business questions into data queries.

new_jobs.description:
Job ID: req4683

Employee Type: exempt full-time

Division: Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate

Facility: Frederick: ATRF

Location: 8560 Progress Dr, Frederick, MD 21701 USA

The Frederick National Laboratory is operated by Leidos Biomedical Research, Inc. The lab addresses some of the most urgent and intractable problems in the biomedical sciences in cancer and AIDS, drug development and first-in-human clinical trials, applications of nanotechnology in medicine, and rapid response to emerging threats of infectious diseases.

Accountability, Compassion, Collaboration, Dedication, Integrity and Versatility; it's the FNL way.

Program Description

The Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate (VICD) has a primary mission to provide scientific leadership and laboratory infrastructure to study immune responses to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines and other cancer preventive strategies in the context of preclinical and clinical studies. As of part of a recent large effort, the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the Frederick National Laboratory (FNL) and other stakeholders are developing and evaluating vaccines with durable protection against influenza. VICD is leading the development of immunoassays with the highest reproducibility, sensitivity, and specificity for evaluation of immune responses induced by vaccination in clinical trials.

The Vaccine, Immunity, and Cancer Directorate (VICD) at the Frederick National Laboratory has a primary mission to provide scientific leadership and laboratory infrastructure to study immune responses to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines, other cancer preventive strategies and other viruses in the context of clinical and pre-clinical studies.

Our core values of accountability, compassion, collaboration, dedication, integrity, and versatility serve as a guidepost for how we do our work every day in serving the public’s interest.

Key Roles/Responsibilities

The Scientific Data Analyst II will be responsible for working directly with VICD Director, Managers and laboratory staff to manage large datasets and conduct data analyses of immunological data, including serology assay data, flow cytometry and other data generated by the laboratory in support of large clinical and epidemiological studies. The incumbent will work closely with the Scientific Manager and laboratory staff to provide statistical analysis, data trending, power calculations and study design. This is an onsite work position. No telework option.

The Scientific Data Analyst Will

Build and manage databasesto support large-scale immunological laboratory datasets.
Perform review of lab data and associated documentation for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to quality standards
Perform validations of templates used for data acquisition and analysis following pre-defined procedures.
Perform complex data analyses, data QC, and data interpretation in a timely manner within projected timelines.
Automate data collection and analysis processes for improved efficiency and reproducibility.
Prepare manual of procedures for data collection and data analyses.
Analyze large amounts of data to identify biomarker measurement trends and patterns employing new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Provide study design guidance to study investigators, such as power calculations and determine most appropriate statistical methods.
Identify appropriate statistical methodology needed to meet study objectives, include assay qualification and validation.
Perform statistical analyses of large, complex datasets from clinical trials and large epidemiological and longitudinal studies using appropriate statistical software packages.
Design and generate tables and graphs in publication-quality form, and present results to managers and directors in a regular basis.
Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical models, and perform statistical analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements.
Prepare and deliver reports for interim and final analyses, including data sections for quality control and validation proposals and reports.
Write and review statistical sections of study proposals, protocols, and manuscripts.
Review study proposals, including clinical trials and apply standards to create summary data reports.
Efficiently troubleshoot or report any unexpected technical and analytical problems.
Effectively communicate with all data generators and submitters to address requests, questions and concerns and clearly document actions taken.

Basic Qualifications

To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below:

Possession of a Master’s degree in Statistics, Computational Sciences, Data Sciences from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) in a related field. Foreign degrees must be evaluated for U.S. equivalency.
In addition to the education requirement, a minimum of two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in data analyses.
Strong knowledge of statistics and scientific data analyses.
Experience working with databases containing large data sets.
Statistical programming languages such as R Script and SAS, applied to biomedical studies.
Experience in evaluation of assay performance by applying appropriate statistical trend analysis.
Strong analytical skills.
Experience with data management, Lab Information Management Systems and data transfer from different platforms.
Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration:

Ph.D. in Statistics, Computational Sciences, Data Sciences.
A minumum of five (5) years related data analyses experience.
Experience in Biomedical Sciences, immunology, or a related scientific discipline or education from an accredited college/university according to CHEA.
Deep understanding and experience in processing high throughput biomedical data: data cleaning, normalization, analysis, interpretation and visualization.
Ability to understand and analyze data from complex experimental and epidemiological designs involving immunology, serology and biomarker assay data.
Proficiency with Python, R, MATLAB, or similar scientific programming languages.
Experience preparing scientific publications and presenting research findings in various technical and scientific forums.
Ability to understand and analyze data from complex experimental and epidemiological designs involving immunology, serology and biomarker assay data.
Experience in assay development, reference standard data analyses in GxP laboratory environment.

JOB HAZARDS

This position is subject to working with or has the potential for exposure to infectious material, requiring medical clearance and immunizations.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, color, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available here

76,800.00 - 110,103.00 USD

new_jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Laboratory Setting

6-month fixed term opportunity

Location: Hybrid, Cambridge

Thermo Fisher's clinical research business is a leading global contract research organization and world leader in serving science. We are passionate, deliberate, and driven by our mission – to enable our clients to make the world healthier, safer, and cleaner.

Within our Analytical Services team, we have a functional service provider solution, which is an outstanding partnership that allows our customers to use the experience of our staff, while allowing you, the employee, to gain direct experience working onsite at a pharmaceutical/ biopharmaceutical company, all while maintaining full-time benefits.

Join Us as a Bioanalysis and Toxicokinetics Project Manager – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation!

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Scientific Project Manager to provide flexible scientific and project-management support across Bioanalysis (BioA), Toxicokinetics (TK) and cross-functional operational improvement activities.

The role will provide experienced, responsive review of BioA and TK reports on an ad hoc basis, while also helping to establish and project manage a portfolio of drug discovery and development activities using Airtable as a new operational platform.

The successful candidate will also contribute to ongoing improvement initiatives focused on strengthening ways of working across Toxicology and Bioanalysis teams.

This is a varied position combining scientific report review, project management, digital workflow implementation and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Airtable Platform Setup & Project Management

Work with key stakeholders to configure Airtable workspaces, bases, views and workflows for selected drug discovery and development projects.
Translate project needs into practical tracking tools for milestones, deliverables, ownership, status, risks, dependencies and decision points.
Maintain project trackers and dashboards to support visibility of non-clinical delivery activities across multiple programmes.
Coordinate project-management routines, including action tracking, follow-up, status reporting and escalation of risks or delays.
Support adoption of Airtable by developing simple instructions, templates and ways-of-working guidance for end users.

Bioanalysis & Toxicokinetic Report Review

Review bioanalytical and toxicokinetic reports on an ad hoc basis, ensuring scientific accuracy, internal consistency and appropriate interpretation of study data.
Check that report content is aligned with agreed study objectives, sample-analysis plans, method-validation expectations and relevant regulatory/scientific guidance.
Identify data inconsistencies, calculation issues, reporting gaps or unclear conclusions, and provide concise, actionable comments to study teams or CRO partners.
Support timely resolution of report-review comments to enable efficient study close-out, decision-making and regulatory readiness.

Process & Ways-of-Working Improvement

Contribute to ongoing process-improvement activities across Toxicology and Bioanalysis teams.
Support development of pragmatic process improvements, including clearer roles, timelines, escalation routes and documentation expectations.
Capture agreed actions, track progress and prepare concise updates for relevant working groups or leadership discussions.
Promote consistent, transparent and efficient ways of working across cross-functional teams.

Skills & Experience

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:

Experience in bioanalysis, toxicokinetics, DMPK, non-clinical development, clinical pharmacology operations or a closely related scientific/project-management environment.
Ability to critically review scientific reports and identify issues in data interpretation, consistency, terminology and conclusions.
Strong project-management capability, with confidence managing multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders.
Practical experience with digital workflow tools. Prior Airtable experience would be advantageous but is not essential if you can rapidly learn and configure new platforms.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to build practical tracking systems.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific or operational information into clear actions, trackers and concise updates.
Clear written communication and the ability to produce concise summaries, action logs and progress updates.
A collaborative working style, with confidence engaging senior scientific and operational stakeholders.
Ability to work independently within a flexible, demand-led support model while maintaining strong alignment with accountable project owners.

Ke
y Stakeho
lders

The role will work closely with Bioanalysis project leads, Toxicology representatives, DMPK colleagues, study monitors, CRO-facing teams and operational stakeholders involved in non-clinical delivery.
You will be expected to coordinate effectively across functions while ensuring accountability remains with the relevant internal project or scientific leads.

What You Will Deliver

During the initial 6-month assignment, key deliverables are expected to include:

Timely completion of assigned BioA and TK report reviews, with clear documented comments and follow-up through to closure.
Configured Airtable bases for agreed discovery/development project areas, including standardised views, ownership fields, milestone tracking and reporting outputs.
Maintained portfolio trackers for selected programmes, with routine status updates and visibility of risks and dependencies.
Draft ways-of-working maps or process summaries describing current state, proposed improvements and agreed next steps across Toxicology and Bioanalysis.
Simple user guidance or templates to enable continued use of Airtable and related project-management processes following completion of the temporary assignment.

Working Model

Initial 6-month temporary assignment.
Flexible, demand-led support model, with priorities agreed with relevant project owners and leadership.
Combination of scientific review activities and structured project-management support.
Expected to operate with limited supervision once priorities, templates and review expectations have been agreed.
Regular check-ins to align workload, review progress and reprioritize as project needs evolve.

Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience - and where your contributions truly make a difference.

What we offer:

As well as being rewarded a competitive salary, we have an extensive benefits package based around the health and well-being of our employees. We have a flexible working culture, where PPD® clinical research services truly value a work-life balance. We’ve grown sustainably year on year but continue to offer a collaborative environment, with teams of colleagues eager to share expertise and have fun together. We are a global organization but with a local feel.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Our 4i Values:

Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement

If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

HMC Architects is an employee-owned design firm with an inherent desire to make a difference in our communities. As a purpose-driven brand based on values, our mission to design for good drives everything we do. And our ownership culture creates alignment and increased commitment to that mission, keeping us on track to being successful.

What We Do

Founded with the purpose of anticipating community needs, HMC aims to create designs that have a positive impact, now and into the future. We focus primarily on opportunities to have the most direct contribution to communities–through healthcare, education, and civic spaces.

Why Join HMC

As an employee owned company you become an owner after one year—receiving company-provided shares at no cost and building long-term financial growth as the firm succeeds. We also give back through our volunteerism with our Designing Futures Foundation, which advances sustainable and regenerative design and supports the next generation of innovators. In addition to this, we also support our team through:

Culture: We put people over profits, giving them the flexibility to manage their work and life. We believe in fairness, equality in opportunity, and rewarding those who perform.
Wellness: company paid wellness courses, on-site gyms (at select locations), access to financial advisors and discounts to wellness platforms, gyms and more.
Professional Development: LinkedIn learning access, business development training, supportive mentorship, company-paid ARE study materials, exam fees, and licensure completion bonuses.
Comprehensive Comp and Benefits: Base+Bonus+Equity+401k, including student loan repayments, wellness programs, full medical, dental, vision, time off and holidays above industry standard.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager
with Healthcare project experience. In this position you will lead all phases of medium to large projects from planning through construction. This role oversees budgeting, scheduling, design development, specifications, and construction documents, while maintaining strong client relationships and resolving architectural challenges. The Project Manager directs and monitors project activities and serves as primary client contact.

The position is located in our San Jose, CA
office. The position requires 3 days in the office and the ability to work from home Mondays and Fridays; Fridays are also half days.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage all phases of architectural projects, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, and billing
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, agencies, consultants, and stakeholders
Supervise, mentor, and evaluate project team members; delegate work and provide performance feedback
Prepare and manage work plans, schedules, staffing projections, and project fees
Oversee design development, construction documents, specifications, and construction administration
Ensure design intent, quality, code compliance, and coordination across all project deliverables
Write and review project correspondence, RFIs, change orders, contracts, and meeting documentation
Coordinate with agencies to resolve plan check and approval issues
Review cost estimates, conduct value analysis, and manage project changes
Participate in marketing efforts, proposals, and client interviews

Requirements

Professional degree in Architecture from an accredited university or equivalent experience
Minimum 7 years of experience in architectural practice, including project management
Strong understanding of contractual obligations, project fees, and budget management
Proven ability to lead teams, delegate effectively, and make sound decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience managing consultants, agencies, and client relationships
Ability to write and edit specifications and oversee construction documentation
Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing multiple priorities

The salary range for this position is $106,331 - $159,101.

The actual salary offered for this position will vary depending on multiple factors including the candidate’s qualification, education, position knowledge, work experience, skills, ability, work location, and internal incumbent compensation for similar roles. We do not anticipate individuals hired into this position will start at or near the top half of the range listed; the decision will be based on each individual case. The salary range listed above does not include other compensation elements such as discretionary bonus opportunities, employee stock ownership grants, paid time off, medical insurance, and other wage and benefit opportunities.

new_jobs.description:
Business Analyst at LayerLab 3D Studio

Location:
Remote - United States

Job Type:
Full Time

Salary:
$68,000-$76,000 per year

About The Role

The Business Analyst opportunity at LayerLab 3D Studio focuses on helping teams connect business needs with clear requirements, process improvements, and evidence-based recommendations. Success in this remote position requires sound judgment, organized analytical work, and the ability to explain findings in practical terms.

Quality matters throughout the process. The successful candidate will approach recurring tasks with consistency while also recognizing when a result deserves additional investigation. Good judgment, careful validation, and concise communication will help ensure that completed work can support practical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate follow-up on open questions, dependencies, and requested changes.
Translate analysis into recommendations that are understandable to both business and technical teams.
Analyze workflows, data, and performance measures to identify gaps and opportunities.
Create clear requirements, process maps, summaries, and supporting documentation.
Gather and organize business requirements from stakeholders and existing documentation.
Help stakeholders define measurable objectives and practical acceptance criteria.

Qualifications

Effective stakeholder communication and careful follow-through.
Comfort analyzing spreadsheets, reports, workflows, and operational information.
Strong business analysis, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage priorities independently in a remote environment.
Ability to gather requirements and document processes clearly.

This role requires consistent ownership of assigned work. You should be comfortable reviewing source information, checking assumptions, identifying missing or inconsistent details, and asking focused questions when clarification is needed. The goal is not simply to produce numbers or reports, but to make sure the underlying work is understandable, traceable, and useful.

Because the position is remote, communication and organization are especially important. You will be expected to maintain clear documentation, provide timely status updates, manage priorities responsibly, and collaborate through shared digital tools. You should be able to work independently while remaining responsive when teammates or stakeholders need context.

This is a full-time remote position for candidates located in the United States. The role calls for dependable execution, professional communication, and a practical approach to analytical work. Candidates who can balance accuracy, initiative, and clear documentation will be well positioned to contribute effectively.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

We're looking for an organized and adaptable Senior Marketing Program Manager to support a variety of projects within our Value Discovery & Retention Product Marketing team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across different types of initiatives, keeping things on track, and helping teams stay aligned. The role supports the extended team spanning Growth Marketing, Engagement Product Marketing, and Community.

Responsibilities

Support planning and execution of engagement product marketing projects
Keep track of timelines, deliverables, and progress across multiple initiatives
Manage project budgets, including tracking spend against plan and flagging variances early
Create and maintain SOWs (statements of work), and track deliverables against them to ensure work stays on scope and on schedule
Coordinate with cross-functional partners such as product, marketing, and engineering
Communicate updates, timelines, and next steps clearly to stakeholders
Help identify and solve issues that may slow down progress
Help implement and improve team processes — not just follow existing ones, but proactively identify opportunities to drive efficiency across the team
Jump into a range of projects, from ongoing work to one-off initiatives

Qualifications

7+ years of experience in project management, marketing, operations, or related work
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage complex, multi-track projects
Experience managing budgets and tracking work against SOWs
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders and drive clarity
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and keep work moving forward in a fast-paced environment
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to loosely defined projects
Ability to take ownership of initiatives and drive them through to completion with minimal oversight
Experience working cross-functionally with product, marketing, and other partner teams
Light technical fluency — comfortable using tools like Jira to collaborate effectively with engineers and product managers

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences.
